description: submission.rs line 599 comment says 'Call-id is #<parent-call-id>' but RFC 8621 §7.5 and the example at RFC 8621 p.85 both show the implicit Email/set uses the SAME call-id as the parent (no # prefix). The actual code at line 611 correctly uses call_id.to_owned(). Only the comment is wrong.
title: submission.rs: wrong call-id comment on implicit Email/set
